shockwave.note: Ground wave of ice spikes travelling right (flip for left). Hurtbox ~ bottom 40 game px. Move the node along the floor.

icicle.note: Falling icicle, 1 game-px tip at the bottom. Show icicle_shadow on the floor ~0.6 s before it lands.

frost_orb.note: Seeker orb (right head). Bursts with ice_burst. Loses track while the player is invisible.

gaze_beam.note: gaze_beam_segment tiles horizontally (texture_repeat + region). Rotate the beam node from the middle head toward the player and sweep it. Origin glow sits on the eyes.

ice_pillar.note: Rises from the floor in phase 3 (roar). 2 tiles wide x 5 tall. Solid top + sides (cover and a temporary platform) for ~8 s, then play backwards and remove.

breath_cone.note: Left head frost breath, pointing right from the mouth, sweeping down to the floor. Leaves slippery_ice where it touches the floor.

slippery_ice.note: Floor patch, tiles horizontally. Lower the player friction while standing on it (~3 s).

ice_burst.note: Generic ice hit / orb burst / icicle shatter.

seal_glow.note: Pulse this over his chest during chest_open (weak point). Additive blend looks best.
